_measurement_discipline: Every number below was captured on a verified-idle GPU (nvidia-smi --query-compute-apps empty) with ECC Disabled and clocks pinned 2040/6251 MHz. dram__bytes_read.sum is DEVICE-WIDE, so a concurrent unprofiled process silently inflates it. Always cross-check against lts__t_sectors_aperture_device_lookup_miss.sum x 32, which is PER-KERNEL. A healthy capture has ratio 1.0000.

superseded_measurements._note: All taken under GPU contention from a concurrent unprofiled process. Retained for provenance only. DO NOT CITE.
superseded_measurements._root_cause: Contention, NOT inline ECC. The ECC hypothesis is refuted by a cross-era test: a fixed hardware ECC overhead must be a fixed percentage, but the excess is ~21% in the Jul-2026 TRT captures and ~12-13% in the Sep-2026 GEMV capture. Both are consistent with a concurrent process holding a roughly constant slice of DRAM read bandwidth (~47 GB/s and ~30 GB/s respectively). ECC reads Disabled/Disabled with no pending change.

open_risks.fp8_accuracy_on_real_weights: OPEN. cos_fp16 = 0.99972 was measured on synthetic Uniform(-0.25, 0.25) weights, the best case for per-tensor E4M3 with no scale factor. Real weights are heavy-tailed. Under validation.
open_risks.fp16_track_conclusion: The FP16 optimization thesis (recover TRT's 1.20x amplification) is VOID. TRT amplification is 1.0006x; there were never excess bytes to recover. This is why FP16 work landed at parity.
